nodes.summary: Let $s$ be an integer sequence that is P-recursive of order $k$ with coefficient polynomials $Q_0, \dots, Q_k$ with integer coefficients, that is, $Q_0(n)\, s_n = \sum_{i=1}^{k} Q_i(n)\, s_{n-i}$ for every $n \ge k$. If $Q_0 = 1$, then $s$ is MC-finite.
nodes.title: P-recursive sequences with leading coefficient 1 are MC-finite

nodes.summary: Let $u_0, \dots, u_k$ be integer sequences and let $P_0, \dots, P_k$ be polynomials with integer coefficients in $k + 2$ variables such that $u_i(n+1) = P_i(u_0(n), \dots, u_k(n), n)$ for every $i \le k$ and every $n \ge 0$. Then the sequence $u_0$ is MC-finite.
nodes.title: Polynomial recursions give MC-finite sequences

nodes.summary: An integer sequence $s$ is MC-finite if for every natural number $m > 0$ it eventually satisfies, modulo $m$, a linear recurrence with constant integer coefficients: there are natural numbers $p > 0$ and $q > 0$ and integers $c_0, \dots, c_{p-1}$ such that $s(n + p) \equiv \sum_{i=0}^{p-1} c_i\, s(n + i) \pmod{m}$ for all $n \ge q$.
nodes.title: MC-finite sequences

nodes.summary: Call an integer sequence $s$ MC-finite if for every natural number $m > 0$ there are natural numbers $p > 0$ and $q > 0$ and integers $c_0, \dots, c_{p-1}$ such that $m$ divides $s(n + p) - \sum_{i=0}^{p-1} c_i\, s(n + i)$ for all $n \ge q$. Every integer sequence $s$ has the following two properties.
nodes.title: Polynomially recursive integer sequences are MC-finite

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
